scope: PATH-01-j: read-only command-resolution priority check for package-manager entry directories, plus apply_tool_config effect reporting
status: implemented-and-isolated-verified; real registry/new-terminal comparison and where.exe cross-check not performed
implementation: CommandResolution resolves a launcher name through an ordered PATH list without executing it and without writing PATH
merged_path_entries combines machine PATH before user PATH, matching the order a new process receives, and expands %VAR% references
unknown %VAR% references are kept verbatim instead of dropping the entry, and quoted entries are unquoted
relative PATH entries are never treated as a match because the process working directory is unknown
PATHEXT drives launcher extension candidates, with .COM/.EXE/.BAT/.CMD as the fallback; a literal file name such as pnpm.cmd is not given extra suffixes
launcher_statuses enumerates at most 12 existing launchers (.exe/.cmd/.bat/.com) in the managed entry directory and resolves each one
PathIntegrationStatus adds command, resolvedCommand, commandStatus, commandDetail and launchers fields; membership status is unchanged
apply_tool_config now reports directory membership, the resolved command target, and any launcher inside the managed entry that a path-earlier install shadows
no launcher is executed; unknown or unreadable registry PATH reports commandStatus=unknown rather than claiming the command works

fixtureCoverage.shadowed_by_user_level_install: a user-level npm directory earlier in PATH wins even though the managed directory is present
fixtureCoverage.managed_first: moving the managed directory first changes the result to managed
fixtureCoverage.missing_command: an absent launcher resolves to missing with no claim of success
fixtureCoverage.literal_file_name: pnpm.cmd is resolved without appending PATHEXT suffixes
fixtureCoverage.non_launcher_skipped: readme.txt in the entry directory is not reported as a launcher
fixtureCoverage.registry_order: machine entries precede user entries in the merged list
fixtureCoverage.quoted_entry: quoted PATH entries are unquoted before comparison

notVerified: No comparison against a real registry/new terminal or where.exe on the host
No real package-manager configuration was written; only temporary fixtures and a simulated UI backend
Command resolution does not model per-user Windows App Paths registrations, shell aliases, or cmd.exe built-in shadowing
No real uv recovery, install, uninstall, packaging or release was performed
notes: The check is intentionally read-only: failing or ambiguous resolution reports a state instead of mutating PATH
A managed entry that is first in the merged PATH is reported as managed even when the launcher itself cannot be executed; execution verification remains out of scope
